tool_args.rationale: The fine trajectory batch is the remaining informative probe: additional measurements can distinguish the threshold region and constrain the collapse before another confirmation attempt.

considered_alternatives.option: Revise and confirm a threshold-avalanche model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The previous model fit the eight training rows exactly but failed fresh confirmation; three high-gradient observations do not identify the collapse shape or its interaction with the base field.
The observations show a gradient-dependent collapse, not high-frequency chaotic sign oscillations, and one failed stationary model does not rule out all smooth mechanisms.
It does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
